MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 15

3. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

4. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 17
   C. 72
   D. 73

5. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

6. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 4
   C. 9
   D. 10

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

8. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 18

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

13. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

14. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
